# Curation entry

- Fit the entry into the existing system-design topic structure.
- State the problem it addresses and the main tradeoff it introduces.
- Record scale consistency availability or operational assumptions when relevant.
- Link canonical or high-quality references.
- Avoid duplicate patterns under different names.
- Keep examples conceptual unless the repository explicitly includes implementation material.
